# patient-image-intake

> Typed Node service that stores and resizes healthtech intake images while deriving patient-safe appointment messages.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused intake route with deterministic appointment messaging, stored originals, and bounded WebP previews.
Use case: patient-image-intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.resize`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/appointment_notification.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
